about: Eight font pairings. Each tier names a role from font-registry.json; type-kit.js renders a tier's words with that role's face and treatment. 'contrast' says what the pairing contrasts (the reason it works).

pairings.name: Helvetica + Garamond
pairings.contrast: neutral grotesque vs. classical italic serif; small vs. large
pairings.rule: Helvetica for every word; Garamond only for the one word the sentence is about

pairings.name: Helvetica + Cormorant Garamond
pairings.contrast: information vs. expression; heavy sans vs. hairline serif
pairings.rule: Cormorant carries the headline; Helvetica carries prices, specs and the CTA

pairings.name: Helvetica + Blacksword
pairings.rule: One script word per scene at most; Blacksword only with a commercial licence, else Italianno (labelled)

pairings.name: Impact + Snell Roundhand
pairings.contrast: tall condensed block vs. flowing script overlapping it
pairings.rule: The script word overlaps the Impact word's top or bottom edge by ~25 % of its cap height

pairings.name: Impact + Rockwell
pairings.rule: Impact for the number or noun, Rockwell for the sentence around it

pairings.name: Rockwell + Helvetica
pairings.rule: Rockwell headline line, Helvetica explanation line below it

pairings.name: Cormorant Garamond + Snell Roundhand
pairings.contrast: upright high-contrast serif vs. connected script
pairings.rule: Sparingly: both faces are loud; one title card, never captions

pairings.name: Impact + Helvetica + Garamond
pairings.contrast: three voices: shout (Impact), say (Helvetica), savour (Garamond italic)
pairings.rule: Impact for problem/warning words, Garamond for the payoff word, Helvetica for the rest; only with a clear hierarchy and room
